question: Does pointwise curvature improve local compatibility and change measured spatial forces at L109? I need the local role/neighborhood context for L109 to judge whether pointwise curvature is compatible with the C12/N22 roles and whether it would alter measured spatial forces, rather than relying on N-count or donor proximity alone. Falsifier: if pointwise curvature leaves the local role assignment and measured force direction/dose unchanged versus the native-geometry L109 record, it does not improve local compatibility. Smallest discriminating test: run pointwise curvature on L109 at the same dose (max_atom_step 0.15 A, native_rms_ratio 0.66) and compare joint_formation, retention_after_formation and mean_pic50 against the R10 L109 record.
